Headers of the AMD FidelityFX SDK API (MIT; the license is at the top of each file), from
https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK at commit
7539ae8b6568ad29ed78a753404351daf3b5cca7 (`Kits/FidelityFX/api/include`,
`Kits/FidelityFX/upscalers/include`). fsr4cap.exe needs them; vendored so that neither
build_assets.sh nor the package clones the SDK.
